_doc: The judge cascade (judges.py, owner's order of 22 Nov 2026). Two judges of different model families read every video in free mode; the stricter answer counts; a writer never judges. gemini: = Google AI Studio with GEMINI_API_KEY from .env (skipped when it is not set); extra: = the owner's FreeLLMAPI; OpenRouter models are taken from its live free list. gemini-2.5-flash is deprecated by Google: from 1 Dec 2026 its requests go to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models, read 22 Nov 2026). The DeepSeek :free ids below were NOT on OpenRouter's list on 22 Nov 2026; they are tried only if they come back.
